subject: The LIVE dispatcher (live-execution/), its seven registered roles and the sealed root they bind (charter DL5: an independent review of the dispatcher before first use).
basis: Rounds pre-seal-1 and pre-seal-2 are seeded from the fix commits' messages and the charter handoff notes (git log 98dfef53a..89e7b0d90). Reconcile each against the review reports before sealing the proof; a finding the reports carry and the commits do not must be added with its disposition. Round pre-seal-final is taken from the seal commit a09e02e94, the charter Progress handoff and the tracker entry it logged; round dl5o from the two review reports as the coordinator relayed them, its fixing commits from git.

severity.P0: blocks every exposure or corrupts a verdict
severity.P1: loses the one-shot read or admits a wrong verdict
severity.P2: a recoverable fault or race on a real path
severity.P3: hardening, documentation or a narrow edge
